response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fielding f JOIN player p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), s AS (SELECT bats, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER () AS avg_cnt FROM c) SELECT bats, cnt, share, cnt - avg_cnt AS above_average FROM s WHERE cnt > avg_cnt;

assumptions.assumption: Fielding records are matched to players with an inner join on player_id, so fielding rows with no matching player are excluded from the counts and from the total.

NULL and empty-string bats values are each their own group (GROUP BY treats NULL as one group and '' as a separate one). The average per hand is the mean of the group counts across all groups, including these.
